ev.q: CDC notified the Florida and Pennsylvania departments of health of four Plasmodium falciparum --associated malaria cases among employees of a single commercial airline.
The two pilots and the other flight attendant were severely ill, were hospitalized, and required intravenous treatment.
Three of the four received diagnoses of acute P. falciparum --associated malaria
